suggested_fixes: (Optional documentation) In README_prepared.txt, add one line clarifying that ddr4_controller_top exposes a transaction-level interface (txn_* / rsp_*) and does not include DDR4 PHY/bus ports, to avoid confusion during integration.
validation_ai_review.summary: Prep bundle appears complete and internally consistent for a first Cadence Genus bring-up. Artifacts (filelist, Tcl, SDC, top_module.txt) agree on TOP=ddr4_controller_top; dependency analysis shows no missing modules/files; selected top is not a testbench/harness and does not expose raw SystemVerilog interface ports at the boundary. Only minor robustness/documentation warnings remain (SDC assumes clk/rst_n if TOP is overridden).
warnings: SDC is hard-coded to create_clock on port clk and set_false_path from rst_n. If TOP is overridden via GENUS_TOP to a module without these ports, Genus will run but be unconstrained or partially constrained. Consider guarding create_clock / reset constraints with get_ports -quiet checks.

The bundle is a behavioral/algorithmic DDR4 controller model (scheduler/queue/FSMs) rather than a PHY-facing controller. That’s fine for Genus bring-up, but ensure expectations are aligned: there are no DDR4 interface pins, only a transaction-level interface (txn_* / rsp_*).
